about: All 264 Disney Lorcana promo printings: the 261 the owner settled on 16 Oct 2026 (Claude Doc 'Promo cards to settle'), less six the owner dropped on 18 Oct (C1's four non-foil twins and its unnumbered 2025 World Champion Mickey, and C2's unnumbered store-event Minnie), and nine the owner added that day, 26/P2's European printing, Vaiana, two Chinese printings, 42/P2 Snow White - Unexpected Houseguest and 43/P2 Stitch - Little Rocket, and six the owner scanned in Japanese, 59/P3 Elsa - Exploring the Unknown, 61/P3 and 62/P3 Maleficent - Monstrous Dragon, 63/P3 Buzz Lightyear - Space Ranger, and 7/P4 and 8/P4 Daisy Duck - Paranormal Investigator. As entries for a card's `variants` array in apps/web/public/data/allCards.json, the shape Epic/Enchanted/Iconic use. Read promo-printings-merge-notes.md first.
